scores.tell: Chair legs and green canvas are uniformly glossy plastic; no fabric weave or stitching, metal tubes read as soft rubber.
Caravan body is smooth matte clay-like; little fine detail, a bit soft and rubbery, but the grass and finish are close to the real cards.
Cauldron stone floor and iron have a realistic, scratchy, painterly texture. It is too gritty and dark, and the metal has no stylized gloss.
Jellyfish is one uniform glossy gradient with airbrush smoothness. Tentacles are flat, and the translucency reads as vector-like.
Beach ball is smooth glossy vinyl with soft highlights, and the sand has fine grain. Only the very clean seams and slightly uniform gloss give it away.
Rock is a smooth, clay-like blob with no grain or rock texture, and the flames are glossy plastic. The material is ambiguous.
Thatch has fine strand detail and the pool water has crisp ripples. The pineapple and wood are stylized like the real cards, and the thatch is slightly busy.
Glossy plastic player with a clean soft finish. Earbud mesh and cable are fine, but the gloss is uniform across the whole body.
